vietnameseName: lãi suất phần trăm hằng năm
oneLine: The yearly cost of borrowing money, shown as a percent.
explanation: APR means annual percentage rate. It shows how much a loan or a credit card costs in one year.
It includes the interest and some fees. A lower APR means the loan costs less.
APR helps you compare two loans of the same type.
whyItMatters: Two loans can have the same monthly payment but a different APR. The one with the higher APR costs more in total. Credit cards often have a high APR, so a balance you do not repay grows fast.
workedExample: You owe $1,000 on a card with a 24% APR. You repay nothing for a year. You pay about $240 in interest, or more.

inTheUs.text: Lenders must show the APR before you sign. This comes from the Truth in Lending rules.

sources.name: CFPB, What is the difference between a loan interest rate and the APR?

inVietnam.text: Banks show a yearly interest rate. The rate may not include every fee.
